sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, good morning! I'm Vivian, your tour guide for today's visit to the Huashan Rock Art Scenic Area. It's a great honor to walk into this cultural sanctuary carrying the millennial Luoyue civilization with you on such a beautiful day. In the following time, I will lead you to appreciate the stunning wonders of Huashan Rock Art and interpret the historical codes behind it. If you have any questions or needs during the trip, please feel free to let me know, and I will try my best to provide you with thoughtful service. Now, let's start this wonderful cultural exploration journey!

Guangxi is located in South China, bordering the Beibu Gulf in the south and Vietnam in the southwest. It has 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction with a permanent population of about 50.27 million. The transportation is convenient, with high-speed railways and highways running through the region, and Nanning Wuxu International Airport connecting domestic and foreign destinations. It has a subtropical monsoon climate with an average annual temperature of about 22℃ and evergreen scenery throughout the year. Historically, it was an important node of the "Maritime Silk Road", where 12 ethnic groups including Zhuang and Han have lived and multiplied for generations. It boasts rich folk customs, such as the Zhuang Nationality's March 3rd Song Festival, hydrangea making, and Zhuang brocade weaving. Specialties like five-color glutinous rice and snail noodles are renowned nationwide.

Chongzuo City is located in southwestern Guangxi, bordering three provinces and cities of Vietnam, governing 7 counties (cities, districts), and is a gateway city from China to ASEAN. The total highway mileage exceeds 11,000 kilometers, including 666 kilometers of expressways, and the transportation network is increasingly improved. The average annual temperature is 22.7℃ with abundant rainfall. As the core area of Luoyue civilization, it has a profound historical heritage. It is rich in tourism resources, with well-known scenic spots such as Detian Transnational Waterfall, Mingshi Pastoral, and Taiping Ancient City. It is also known as the "Sugar Capital of China" with a developed sugar industry. In 2024, the service industry grew steadily, industries such as wholesale and retail, transportation continued to develop, and the integration of culture and tourism achieved remarkable results.

Huashan Rock Art Scenic Area is located in four counties (districts) including Ningming County and Longzhou County of Chongzuo City. As the core area of the Zuojiang Huashan Rock Art Cultural Landscape, it was inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List in 2016. The heritage area covers a total area of 6621.6 hectares, including 38 rock art sites, 109 rock art groups, and 4050 images. Distributed along the steep cliff faces over 200 kilometers on both banks of the Zuojiang River, it forms a unique cultural landscape together with the cliffs, rivers and terraces. The scenic area takes the reddish-brown rock art as the core attraction, with supporting facilities such as a tourist center, viewing platforms and a cruise terminal. Tourists can enjoy the charm of rock art through two ways: land viewing and water tour.

These rock arts were created during the Warring States Period to the Eastern Han Dynasty, i.e., the 5th century BC to the 2nd century AD. They are masterpieces of the Luoyue people, ancestors of the Zhuang Nationality, with a history of more than 2,000 years. The Luoyue people used hematite powder mixed with animal fat as pigment to paint on cliff faces as high as tens of meters or even hundreds of meters. Historically, Huashan Rock Art was mentioned in many ancient books, but its systematic research began in the 1950s. Through the unremitting efforts of archaeologists, the mystery of the rock art has been gradually uncovered, confirming that it is a recording carrier for the Luoyue people's major activities such as sacrifices and celebrations, witnessing the social structure and spiritual world at that time.

The most representative in the scenic area is the Huashan Rock Art Site in Ningming County, where the rock art is the largest in scale and most concentrated in images. A single painting is as high as 40 meters and 170 meters wide, containing more than 1,900 images, which is the essence of the entire heritage area. The rock art images are mainly human figures, accounting for more than 80%, followed by animals and utensils. Most of the human figures are in a posture of front face, arms raised and legs spread apart. The tallest is 3 meters high and the shortest is only 0.3 meters. Some figures wear knives around their waists and hold objects in their hands, which are presumed to be tribal leaders or ritualists. Animal images are mostly dogs, horses and deer, and utensils include bronze drums, swords, etc. Among them, the bronze drum image is an important symbol of Luoyue culture.

In addition to the core rock art sites, the Zuojiang scenery in the scenic area is also very charming. The clear and winding river is surrounded by exotic peaks on both banks, which complement the rock art. The main viewing nodes include Huashan Viewing Platform, Rock Art Plank Road and Cruise Viewing Line. The viewing platform overlooks the panoramic view of the rock art and the Zuojiang bend; the plank road is built along the cliff wall, allowing close observation of the details of the rock art; the cruise ship shows the integrated beauty of the rock art and the natural environment from the waterway.

Due to the long history, the identities of specific figures in the rock art cannot be accurately verified. However, judging from the scale and posture of the images, there were core figures such as tribal leaders and priests, who played a leading role in sacrificial activities and embodied the hierarchical system of Luoyue society. In terms of historical events, the rock art as a whole records the large-scale sacrificial ceremonies of the Luoyue people, which may be related to major scenarios such as praying for blessings, battles and harvests. Among them, multiple groups of figures surrounding bronze drums reflect the sacred status of bronze drums in Luoyue culture - they are both musical instruments and symbols of power. On July 15, 2016, the Zuojiang Huashan Rock Art Cultural Landscape was successfully inscribed on the World Heritage List at the 40th World Heritage Conference held in Istanbul, Turkey. This is China's 49th World Heritage and the world's first rock art world cultural heritage, marking that its value has been recognized internationally.

To allow everyone to fully experience the charm of the scenic area, we recommend a combined tour route of "land + water", which takes about 2.5 hours. First, start from the tourist center and take the scenic sightseeing bus to Huashan Viewing Platform. Stay here for 15 minutes to overlook the panoramic view of Ningming Huashan Rock Art and feel its grand momentum; then go to the Rock Art Plank Road and take a 30-minute walk to observe the color, lines and image details of the rock art up close and listen to the stories of archaeological discoveries; then return to the cruise terminal near the tourist center and take a sightseeing cruise for a 1-hour water tour to enjoy the perfect integration of rock art and Zuojiang landscape from the river perspective. During the trip, the guide will explain the geology, landform and folk legends on both banks; finally, the cruise ship returns to the terminal. After the trip, you can buy characteristic souvenirs such as Zhuang brocade and hydrangea in the cultural and creative area of the tourist center.

The value of Huashan Rock Art is reflected in multiple dimensions. In terms of historical value, it is direct physical evidence of the Luoyue society from the Warring States Period to the Eastern Han Dynasty, filling the gap in the study of social history in the Lingnan area during this period and providing an important basis for understanding ancient ethnic relations and the level of productive forces development. In terms of cultural value, as the spiritual core of Luoyue civilization, the rock art carries the ancestors' religious beliefs, sacrificial customs and aesthetic concepts. It is an important root of cultural inheritance of ethnic minorities such as the Zhuang Nationality, and folk activities such as the March 3rd Song Festival have a profound cultural origin with it.

In terms of scientific value, the pigment formula (hematite powder, animal fat, etc.) and painting techniques (painting methods on steep cliff walls) of the rock art show the wisdom of the ancient Luoyue people. The fact that it has maintained bright colors after more than 2,000 years of wind and rain provides a vivid case for the study of ancient material science and environmental protection. In terms of artistic value, the rock art adopts simple and powerful lines and exaggerated modeling techniques, forming a unique "Luoyue art style". The dynamic sense of human figures and the sense of rhythm of group composition are extremely strong. It is the pinnacle of rock art in southern China and has exerted a profound influence on the development of ethnic art in later generations.

Dear tourists, happy time is always short, and today's trip to Huashan Rock Art is coming to an end. I believe that through today's visit, you have not only appreciated the shocking beauty of the world heritage, but also gained a deeper understanding of Luoyue civilization and Zhuang culture. Huashan Rock Art is a precious treasure left by our ancestors, which requires us to jointly protect and inherit.

Thank you very much for your cooperation and support along the way. Please forgive me if there are any deficiencies in my explanation. I hope the mystery and grandeur of Huashan Rock Art can become an unforgettable memory in your hearts. You are also welcome to come to Guangxi and Chongzuo again to explore more ethnic customs and natural wonders. Finally, I wish you a pleasant journey and a safe trip! Goodbye!

sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, good morning! I'm Vivian, your guide for today's trip to Chengyang Eight Villages. It's a great honor to have the opportunity to accompany you to appreciate the unique charm of this Dong ethnic ancient village. During the following journey, I will introduce you in detail the historical culture, characteristic landscapes and folk customs of the Dong ethnic group. If you have any questions or needs, please feel free to let me know, and I will try my best to solve them for you. Now, let's start today's wonderful journey!

Dear friends, before arriving at Chengyang Eight Villages, let's first learn about the basic situation of Guangxi and Liuzhou. Guangxi is located in the southern part of China, bordering Vietnam, with 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction and a total population of about 57 million. The transportation is very convenient, with a three-dimensional transportation network composed of high-speed railways, aviation, highways and water transportation. It has a subtropical monsoon climate, with spring-like weather all year round and abundant precipitation. Guangxi has a long history. As early as the Paleolithic Age, there were human activities here. It is a multi-ethnic settlement where 12 ethnic groups such as Zhuang, Han and Yao have lived for generations, with rich folk customs, such as the Zhuang's March 3rd Song Fair and the Yao's Panwang Festival. There are abundant local specialties, including Guilin rice noodles, Nanning old friend noodles, Zhuang brocade, Nixing pottery, etc. It has unique tourism resources, with well-known scenic spots such as Guilin Landscape and Beihai Silver Beach. Today, Guangxi's economy is developing steadily, with close cooperation with ASEAN, a harmonious society and vigorous development of cultural undertakings.

Liuzhou, as an important city in central Guangxi, has 5 districts and 5 counties under its jurisdiction, with a total population of about 4.1 million. It is an important transportation hub in the southwest region, where Xianggui, Qiangui and other railways meet, and highways and water transportation are developed. It has a subtropical monsoon climate, with long summers and short winters, and a pleasant climate. Its history can be traced back to the Han Dynasty, known as "Tanzhong" in ancient times, and it was an important commercial port in the Ming and Qing Dynasties. It is a multi-ethnic settlement, and the folk cultures of Dong, Zhuang and other ethnic groups are unique. Local specialties include Liuzhou snail noodles, Liugong machinery, Liuzhou rare stones, etc. There are rich tourism landscapes. In addition to Chengyang Eight Villages, there are also Liuhou Park, Yufeng Mountain and other scenic spots. Today, Liuzhou has strong industrial strength and is an important industrial town in Guangxi. At the same time, it pays attention to ecological construction, and social and cultural undertakings are constantly making progress.

Dear tourists, now we have arrived at Chengyang Eight Villages Scenic Area. Chengyang Eight Villages is located in Sanjiang Dong Autonomous County of Liuzhou City, consisting of eight Dong ethnic natural villages including Chengyang, Ma'an and Pingzhai, with a total area of about 12.5 square kilometers. It is a typical representative of Dong ethnic settlements. It has a long history. According to historical records, as early as the Southern Song Dynasty, the ancestors of the Dong ethnic group settled here, and it has a history of more than 800 years. After generations of reproduction, it has formed a large-scale and reasonably arranged village community today.

When it comes to the representative landscape of Chengyang Eight Villages, we have to mention Chengyang Wind and Rain Bridge, which is the "treasure of the village" of the scenic area and an outstanding model of Chinese wood structure architecture. This bridge was built in 1912 and completed in 1924. It is 64.4 meters long, 3.4 meters wide and 10.6 meters high. It is entirely made of Chinese fir, without a single nail or rivet, and relies entirely on wooden tenons for connection, which fully demonstrates the superb architectural skills of the Dong people. The bridge has a simple and elegant shape, with five tower-like pavilions on it. The pavilions have curved eaves and carved exquisitely. The patterns are mostly auspicious patterns and life scenes of the Dong ethnic group, which have extremely high artistic value. In 1982, Chengyang Wind and Rain Bridge was listed as a national key cultural relics protection unit.

In addition to Chengyang Wind and Rain Bridge, there are many scenic spots worth seeing in the scenic area. For example, the Drum Tower in Pingzhai. The Drum Tower is the core building of the Dong village and an important place for villagers to discuss affairs, offer sacrifices and entertain. Pingzhai Drum Tower is about 20 meters high, with 11 floors. The body of the building is carved with exquisite Dong patterns, and the roof is a pointed roof, with a magnificent shape. There are also stilted buildings in Ma'anzhai. Stilted buildings are traditional dwellings of the Dong ethnic group, built against mountains and adjacent to water. They make full use of topographical advantages, which are not only ventilated and moisture-proof, but also beautiful and practical. The stilted buildings have exquisite architectural craftsmanship. The building body is supported by wooden columns, the floors and walls are mostly made of Chinese fir, and the roof is covered with small green tiles. The overall shape is scattered and integrated with the natural environment.

In history, there were many important figures and events in Chengyang Eight Villages. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was an important commercial port at the junction of Hunan, Guizhou and Guangxi provinces. Many Dong merchants did business here, which promoted the local economic development and cultural exchanges. Since modern times, the construction of Chengyang Wind and Rain Bridge has condensed the wisdom and sweat of Dong craftsmen. Represented by Dong craftsman Lei Wenxing, he led many craftsmen to spend 12 years to complete this great building, which has become a symbol of the wisdom of the Dong people.

Next, I will introduce our tour route to you. First, we enter from the scenic area entrance and visit Chengyang Wind and Rain Bridge to learn about its architectural craftsmanship, history and culture in detail; then we go to Pingzhai to visit Pingzhai Drum Tower and the surrounding stilted buildings to feel the layout of the Dong village and the characteristics of dwellings; after that, we will go to Ma'anzhai to experience Dong folk activities, such as Dong Grand Chorus performances and making oil tea; finally, we will go to the specialty store of the scenic area, where you can buy some Dong handicrafts, such as Dong embroidery and silver ornaments, as souvenirs.

Chengyang Eight Villages not only has a profound historical and cultural heritage, but also contains rich scientific and artistic values. From a scientific point of view, the wood structure architectural technology of the Wind and Rain Bridge shows the Dong people's proficient use of mechanical principles, and the architectural layout of the stilted buildings reflects the concept of harmonious coexistence between man and nature; from an artistic point of view, the carvings and paintings of the Wind and Rain Bridge and Drum Tower, the Dong embroidery, silver jewelry craftsmanship, and folk arts such as Dong Grand Chorus are all treasures in the art treasure house of the Chinese nation. The folk customs here are also very rich. During traditional festivals such as the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival, the villagers will hold grand celebration activities, playing Lusheng and dancing the Caitang Dance, which is very lively.

Dear tourists, happy time always passes quickly, and today's trip to Chengyang Eight Villages is coming to an end. I believe that through today's tour, everyone has a deeper understanding and feeling of the history, culture, architectural art and folk customs of the Dong ethnic group. The simple charm of Chengyang Eight Villages and the enthusiasm and hospitality of the Dong people must have left a deep impression on everyone.

During today's trip, thank you for your understanding, support and cooperation with my work. If there are any shortcomings in my explanation, please forgive me. I hope the beautiful scenery and culture of Chengyang Eight Villages can become a good memory in everyone's heart. You are also welcome to come to Guangxi, Liuzhou and Chengyang Eight Villages again. I am very happy to be your guide again. Finally, I wish you a safe journey, good health and all the best! Goodbye!

sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, hello! Welcome to Guilin, the city renowned as "the most beautiful landscape under heaven". I'm Vivian, your guide for today's tour of the Two Rivers and Four Lakes · Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area. In the following hours, we will wander between the rivers and lakes surrounded by clear waves, gaze at the thousand-year posture of Elephant Trunk Hill, the city emblem, and experience the unique charm of the integration of nature and humanity. Please feel free to let me know if you have any questions or needs during the trip. I hope this journey will leave you unforgettable memories!

Guangxi, abbreviated as "Gui" with Nanning as its capital, is located in southern China, bordering the Beibu Gulf in the south and Vietnam in the southwest. It is the only ethnic autonomous region in China with coastal, border and riverfront advantages, covering a land area of 237,600 square kilometers. The region administers 14 prefecture-level cities, with a permanent population of 50.27 million by the end of 2023, among which the Zhuang ethnic group accounts for 31.39%. Twelve indigenous ethnic groups have nurtured unique folk customs such as the March 3rd Song Festival and bronze drum culture. It has a subtropical monsoon climate with warm weather and abundant rainfall. With a three-dimensional transportation network micro-network consisting of high-speed railways, airports and ports, it is a major transportation hub for southwest China to access the sea. Economically, non-ferrous metals industry and trade with ASEAN are booming, and the integration of culture and tourism has achieved remarkable results.

Guilin, a key city in northeastern Guangxi, administers 6 districts and 10 counties with a permanent population of 4.94 million. It is a world-famous tourist city and a famous historical and cultural city. With a history of more than 2,000 years since the construction of the Lingqu Canal in the Qin Dynasty, it is vividly described by Han Yu's poem: "Rivers are like green silk ribbons, mountains like green jade hairpins". Karst landforms are widely distributed here, with the Li River and Elephant Trunk Hill world-renowned. It also boasts special local products such as Guilin rice noodles and luohanguo (monk fruit). Today, Guilin focuses on ecological tourism and develops high-end manufacturing, with prosperous social culture, becoming a model of harmonious coexistence between man and nature.

Covering an area of about 3.1 square kilometers, the Two Rivers and Four Lakes · Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is the core water landscape belt in the center of Guilin. It consists of "two rivers" - the Li River and Taohua River, "four lakes" - Ronghu Lake, Shanhu Lake, Guihu Lake and Mulong Lake, as well as classic famous mountains such as Elephant Trunk Hill, Fubo Hill and Diecai Hill. It perfectly integrates natural landscapes with urban landscapes, creating a unique artistic conception of "the city lies in the scenery and the scenery is in the city". It served as the southern branch venue of the CCTV Spring Festival Gala in 2017 and hosted the Guangxi main venue event of the National Ecological Day in 2024.

The history of the scenic area can be traced back to the Song Dynasty, when a relatively complete moat water system had been formed. As the core landscape, Elephant Trunk Hill has been a tourist attraction since the Tang Dynasty, and the name "Shuiyue Cave" (Water-Moon Cave) has been used since the Qiandao period of the Southern Song Dynasty. In modern times, the scenic area has undergone successive renovations. The Two Rivers and Four Lakes Project launched in 1998 connected the originally disconnected rivers and lakes through modern technologies such as the Mulong Lake ship lift, recreating the grand scene of the Song Dynasty described as "thousands of peaks stand around the wilderness, and a river encircles the city". Elephant Trunk Hill was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995, becoming the spiritual symbol of the city.

Undoubtedly, Elephant Trunk Hill is the soul of the scenic area. This karst wonder formed by marine sedimentary limestone 360 million years ago gets its name from its shape resembling a giant elephant drinking water. Its iconic landscape, Shuiyue Cave, preserves 22 stone carvings from the Tang and Song Dynasties with a total of 3,065 characters, winning the Guinness World Record for "the water cave with the most characters on cave wall carvings". Calligraphy works by literati such as Han Yu and Lu You are preserved here. The Puxian Pagoda on the top of the hill is a Lamaist solid brick pagoda from the Ming Dynasty, where you can overlook the whole view of the Li River.

Each of the Two Rivers and Four Lakes has its own characteristics: the ancient banyan double bridges by Ronghu Lake witness the vicissitudes of time; the Sun and Moon Twin Towers by Shanhu Lake show the charm of modern light and shadow; the pavilions and towers by Guihu Lake reveal the style of the Tang and Song Dynasties; the ancient city wall and ship lift of Mulong Lake tell the story of the integration of ancient and modern times. In addition, the Yunfeng Temple in the scenic area was once the headquarters of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom rebels, and now there is a revolutionary site exhibition hall, carrying red memories.

Literati of all dynasties have left countless poems for Guilin's landscapes. The poem "Rivers are like green silk ribbons, mountains like green jade hairpins" by Han Yu in the Tang Dynasty is a masterpiece through the ages, and the verse "The water flows but the moon remains, the moon leaves but the water still flows" by a scholar from Jibei in the Song Dynasty accurately describes the artistic conception of the water-moon scene at Elephant Trunk Hill. In modern times, the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom rebels set up their headquarters in Yunfeng Temple, leaving precious revolutionary relics. In contemporary times, the southern branch venue of the 2017 CCTV Spring Festival Gala was set at Elephant Trunk Hill, allowing the wonder of "Elephant Trunk Hill with water and moon" to reach the whole country through the screen. Many Chinese and foreign dignitaries have also visited the scenic area and praised its unique charm.

It is recommended that you choose the boat tour route: "Elephant Trunk Hill Wharf - Mulong Lake - Guihu Lake - Ronghu Lake - Shanhu Lake - Taohua River - Li River". The whole journey takes about 90 minutes, where you can experience the wonder of passing the dam via the ship lift and enjoy the night tour spectacle of "the moon in the sky, the moon in the cave and the moon in the water" shining together. For the walking tour, you can enter through the main gate of Elephant Trunk Hill, climb to the top to view the river, then stroll along the footpath by Ronghu and Shanhu Lakes to enjoy the comfort of the integration of city and scenery.

The scenic area contains multiple values: scientifically, it is a natural museum for karst landform evolution, with a 360 million-year geological history of great research significance; culturally, stone carvings, poems and folk customs form a three-dimensional cultural system, which is an important carrier of Lingnan culture; artistically, the landscape like a painting has inspired countless artistic creations, being a model of Chinese landscape aesthetics; ecologically, the river and lake wetlands regulate the climate and nourish all things, and it has been rated as a national ecological tourism demonstration base.

Dear tourists, today's tour of the Two Rivers and Four Lakes · Elephant Trunk Hill is coming to an end. I believe the graceful mountains, clear waters of Guilin and the thousand-year heritage of Elephant Trunk Hill have been deeply engraved in your hearts. On the occasion of parting, I hope you can take away the fragrant taste of Guilin rice noodles, the sweet flavor of luohanguo and this bond with the mountains and waters. Thank you for your cooperation and trust. I wish you a smooth journey home and good health. Looking forward to meeting you again in this beautiful landscape!

sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, good morning! I'm Vivian, your tour guide who will accompany you to explore the Lijiang River today. First of all, on behalf of the travel agency and all staff, please allow me to extend our warmest welcome to your arrival! In the following time, we will appreciate the beautiful scenery of the Lijiang River which is described as "the river like a green silk ribbon, the mountains like jade hairpins", and feel the unique charm of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and Guilin City. If you have any needs during the trip, such as adjusting the tour rhythm or consulting about scenic spots, please feel free to tell me at any time, and I will try my best to serve you. Now, let's start this unforgettable journey of mountains and rivers!

Guangxi, abbreviated as "Gui" with Nanning as its capital, borders the Beibu Gulf in the south and Vietnam in the southwest. It is the only ethnic autonomous region in China with coastal, border and riverfront advantages. The region covers an area of 237,600 square kilometers, with a registered population of 57.48 million by the end of 2023. There are 12 ethnic groups living here for generations, including Zhuang and Han, among which the Zhuang population accounts for 32.49%. It has a subtropical monsoon climate, which is warm and humid, pleasant in all seasons. With convenient transportation, a three-dimensional network composed of high-speed railways, highways and airports has been formed, making it a major sea outlet for southwest China.

Guilin is a central city in northeastern Guangxi, governing 6 districts and 10 counties. It is a world-famous tourist city and a famous historical and cultural city. The reputation of "Guilin's mountains and waters are the best under heaven" has lasted for thousands of years. There are not only classic landscapes such as Lijiang River and Elephant Trunk Hill, but also folk customs like the Zhuang nationality's March 3rd Festival and the Yao nationality's long drum dance. Local specialties include Guilin rice noodles and Yangshuo kumquats. Today, Guilin has developed through the integration of culture and tourism, with steady economic growth and harmonious and stable society, becoming a desirable destination for Chinese and foreign tourists.

Dear tourists, the Lijiang River in front of us is an important tributary of the Xijiang River system in the Pearl River Basin and the soul of Guilin's mountains and waters. The Lijiang River Scenic Area starts from Mao'er Mountain in Xing'an in the north and ends at Bilian Peak in Yangshuo in the south, with a total length of 164 kilometers. The core tourist section is about 83 kilometers from Mopan Mountain Wharf in Guilin to Longtou Mountain Wharf in Yangshuo, which is also our tourist route today.

The history of the Lijiang River can be traced back to ancient times. After hundreds of millions of years of water erosion, the karst landform has formed the unique landscape of "clear mountains, beautiful waters, exotic caves and beautiful stones" today. As early as the Southern and Northern Dynasties, literati and scholars praised the Lijiang River. The poem "the river like a green silk ribbon, the mountains like jade hairpins" written by Han Yu, a poet of the Tang Dynasty, has become an eternal masterpiece. Since modern times, famous artists such as Xu Beihong and Qi Baishi have come here to sketch many times, integrating the beautiful scenery of the Lijiang River into their paintings and making it famous all over the world. In 1998, the Lijiang River Scenic Area was listed as a national key scenic spot; in 2007, it became a national 5A-level tourist attraction; in 2014, the "South China Karst" with the Lijiang River as the core was included in the World Natural Heritage List.

Next, we will focus on several representative landscapes. The first one is "Huangbu Reflection", located near Xingping Town in the lower reaches of the Lijiang River. The river here is wide and calm, and the yellow cloth stone under the water is clearly visible. The mountain peaks on both sides are reflected in the water, forming the wonderful scene of "the boat sails on the top of green mountains". It is also the shooting location of the pattern on the back of the 20-yuan RMB. You can take out your mobile phones or cameras to record this classic picture.

Not far ahead is "Nine Horses Painting Hill". This mountain is about 400 meters high. On the stone wall, due to the rock texture and vegetation distribution, nine horses' patterns are naturally formed, with different shapes and vivid images. There is a local saying: "Horse-watching guy, horse-watching guy, how many pairs of divine horses do you see? Seeing seven makes you the second place in the imperial examination, seeing nine makes you the top scholar." You might as well identify carefully and see how many horses you can find. It is said that Premier Zhou Enlai and Marshal Chen Yi saw nine and seven horses respectively when they visited here, which shows the wonder of this landscape.

In terms of scientific value, the karst landform in the Lijiang River basin is a natural laboratory for studying the erosion and evolution of carbonate rocks. Its complete development process and rich geomorphic types provide valuable samples for the research of geology, geography and other disciplines. In terms of cultural and artistic value, the Lijiang River is not only the source of inspiration for literati and scholars, but also breeds a unique "landscape culture". Guilin landscape painting is an important school of Chinese landscape painting. There are countless poems, paintings, film and television works themed on the Lijiang River, which have become treasures in the cultural treasure house of the Chinese nation.

Our tour today will go downstream along Mopan Mountain Wharf, passing through scenic spots such as Wangfu Stone, Caoping, Yangdi and Xingping in turn, and finally arrive at Longtou Mountain Wharf in Yangshuo. Along the way, you can enjoy the exotic peaks and stones on both sides and feel the artistic conception of "the boat sails on the blue waves, and people travel in the painting". It should be reminded that the ecological environment of the Lijiang River is fragile. For many years, the local government has been committed to ecological protection, prohibiting deforestation and sewage discharge. It is also hoped that all tourists will take good care of the environment, not litter, and jointly protect this natural beauty.

Dear tourists, happy time always passes quickly, and our Lijiang River tour today is coming to an end. I believe that the green mountains and clear waters, exotic peaks and stones of the Lijiang River, as well as the folk customs of Guilin, Guangxi, have all left a deep impression on everyone. During this journey, thank you for your understanding, support and cooperation with my work. If there is any inadequacy in my service, please forgive me.

Parting is for a better reunion. Guilin and Lijiang River will always open their arms to everyone. I hope that after you go back, you can share the beautiful scenery and stories here with your relatives and friends around you. I also look forward to meeting you again on this picturesque land one day in the future. Finally, I wish you a safe journey, good health and all the best! Goodbye!

sections.text: Dear tourists, good morning! Welcome to Qingxiu Mountain Scenic Area, the business card of Nanning, known as the "Green City of China"! I'm Vivian, your tour guide today. It's a great honor to explore the unique charm of this "rainforest mountain" and "cultural vein mountain" with you. During the following tour, I will introduce the general situation of Guangxi and Nanning, as well as the natural and humanistic landscapes of Qingxiu Mountain in detail. Please pay attention to your step safety, take good care of your personal belongings, and also protect the plants in the scenic area. Now, let's start today's wonderful journey!

Guangxi is located in the southern border of China, adjacent to Guangdong in the east, Yunnan in the west, Beibu Gulf in the south, and bordering Vietnam. It is the only ethnic autonomous region with a coastline in China, governing 14 prefecture-level cities and having a permanent population of about 50.27 million. As a frontier for China-ASEAN cooperation, Guangxi has a well-developed transportation network. Nanning Wuxu International Airport connects to many places around the world, and the high-speed rail and expressway networks cover the whole region. It has a subtropical monsoon climate, with evergreen scenery throughout the year and an average annual temperature of about 20℃. Guangxi has a long history: it was set as Guilin County in the Qin Dynasty, became Guangxi Province in the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and established as an autonomous region in 1958. Eleven indigenous ethnic groups including the Zhuang nationality have created brilliant cultures, such as the "March 3rd" Song Fair, Zhuang brocade weaving and bronze drum culture, which are renowned at home and abroad. Specialties include Guilin rice noodles, Liuzhou river snail noodles, Nanning Laoyou noodles, as well as momordica grosvenori and star anise. It is rich in tourism resources, with famous scenic spots such as Guilin landscape and Beihai Silver Beach. Now Guangxi's economy is developing steadily. The ASEAN Expo is held in Nanning every year, promoting in-depth cooperation in culture, tourism, economy and trade. As the capital city, Nanning is a transportation hub and cultural tourism core in southwest China, well-deserving the reputation of "Green City of China".

Located in the southeast of Nanning urban area, only 8 kilometers away from the city center, Qingxiu Mountain covers a total area of 13.54 square kilometers with an altitude of 289 meters and a forest coverage rate of 98%, which is a veritable "urban green lung" and "natural oxygen bar". As a national 5A-level scenic area, it is not only a "living natural museum" composed of nearly 10,000 kinds of plants, but also bears the thousand-year cultural vein of Yongzhou. With nearly 9 million tourists in 2024, it is a core scenic area integrating ecological protection, cultural inheritance and tourism and leisure. The transformation of Qingxiu Mountain from a single fast-growing forest farm in the early years to today's ecological and cultural resort has condensed the efforts of several generations of guardians.

The reputation of Qingxiu Mountain has been spread since the Tang Dynasty, but what really enriches its cultural connotation is Wang Yangming, a great Confucian in the Ming Dynasty. In the sixth year of Jiajing in the Ming Dynasty (1527), Wang Yangming was ordered to put down the "Sitian Rebellion". During his garrison in Nanning, he set up the governor's office in Qingxiu Mountain, implemented benevolent governance and spread the philosophy of mind. His disciple Ouyang Yu, to express gratitude to his teacher, carved "The Place Where Mr. Yangming Spread Enlightenment" on Xieqing Rock in the mountain in the 40th year of Jiajing. "Guohua" (spread enlightenment) is derived from "The Analects of Mencius" meaning "a man of virtue enlightens wherever he goes", highlighting his educational achievements. This cliff carving has become a cultural landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. Since the Ming and Qing Dynasties, officials taking office in Nanning often came to pay their respects. In addition, Qingxiu Mountain has completed a gorgeous transformation in modern times: through soil improvement, ecological regulation and other measures, it has transformed from a forest farm to a scenic area. The cycad protection team has revitalized the endangered cycads and realized their return to the wild.

Today we will take a classic "nature + culture" route: enter from the west gate and first visit the core ecological landscape - Cycad Garden. There are nearly 50,000 cycads here, including the thousand-year-old "Cycad King". It is the largest cycad germplasm resource base in China. Popular science volunteers will explain their unique growth habits to you, showing ecological and scientific value. Then go up along the ancient road to Xieqing Rock, watch the stone carving "The Place Where Mr. Yangming Spread Enlightenment" and feel the profound influence of the philosophy of mind. Then go to the Longxiang Pagoda on the top of the mountain. This ancient pagoda of the Ming Dynasty is the highest point of Qingxiu Mountain. Climbing the pagoda, you can overlook the winding Yongjiang River and the panoramic view of the city. The architectural structure of the pagoda reflects the artistic attainments of craftsmen in the Ming Dynasty. On the way down the mountain, visit Guanyin Zen Temple to experience the blessing culture, and finally go to the Orchid Garden to appreciate famous orchids in all seasons. There are nearly 100 kinds of characteristic products in the cultural and creative store in the garden for purchase. There are also more than 200 kinds of wild birds inhabiting along the way. You can pay attention to the movements in the forest and experience the artistic conception of "birds singing and flowers fragrant".

The value of Qingxiu Mountain is diverse: ecologically, the 98% forest coverage purifies the air and becomes an urban ecological barrier. The protection of endangered species such as cycads has achieved scientific breakthroughs, making it a model of ecological restoration; culturally, the remains such as Wang Yangming's lectures, ancient pagodas and ancient roads carry Confucian culture and local folk customs. Activities such as the "March 3rd" Song Fair and thousands of guzheng performances enable the living inheritance of ethnic culture; artistically, the symmetrical aesthetics of Longxiang Pagoda and the calligraphy art of cliff carvings show the artistic accomplishment of ancient craftsmen and scholars; economically, the scenic area has transformed from "ticket economy" to "secondary consumption", driving cultural and tourism consumption through flower appreciation economy and night tour projects. With nearly 9 million annual tourists, it has achieved a win-win situation in ecology, society and economy.

Dear tourists, today's tour of Qingxiu Mountain is coming to an end. I believe this treasure mountain integrating greenery and cultural veins has left a deep impression on everyone - whether it is the vitality of Cycad Garden, the grandeur of Longxiang Pagoda, or the profoundness of Wang Yangming's stone carvings, they all carry the natural and humanistic codes of Nanning. Thank you for your cooperation and listening along the way. If you have the chance, welcome to come to the "Green City of China" again to explore more landscapes and customs of Guangxi. Finally, I wish you a smooth journey, peace and joy, goodbye!

sections.text: Dear tourists, hello everyone! I'm your tour guide for this "Karst Exploration Journey". It's a great honor to start this wonderful trip from Guilin to Hechi with all of you. In the following time, we will travel through the most representative karst secrets in Guangxi, and experience the uncanny craftsmanship of nature and the profound heritage of history and culture. Located in southern China, Guangxi borders Vietnam and has 14 prefecture-level cities under its administrative division with a total population of about 57 million. As one of the regions with the most developed and extensive karst landforms in China, karst area in Guangxi accounts for 37.8% of the total area of the region, with peak forests, peak clusters, karst caves and other landscapes everywhere. In addition to karst landforms, Guangxi also has Danxia landforms with red mountains and clear waters, beautiful rivers in the Pearl River Basin, and coastal customs of the Beibu Gulf, with highly diverse natural landscapes. Historically, Guangxi was an important node of the "Maritime Silk Road", where 12 ethnic groups including Zhuang, Han and Yao have lived and multiplied for generations, creating a rich and colorful ethnic culture.

Guilin, the starting point of our trip, is located in the northeastern part of Guangxi. It is a world-famous tourist city with a total population of about 5.4 million. Guilin is famous for its "clear mountains, beautiful waters, strange caves and beautiful stones". Karst landforms are most typically developed here, and it is known as "Guilin's mountains and waters are the best in the world". Hechi, the second stop of the trip, is located in the northwestern part of Guangxi with a total population of about 4.3 million. It is a model of the perfect combination of karst landforms and ecological protection, with many original karst ecological landscapes, making it an excellent place to explore karst secrets.

The first scenic spot we visit is Guilin Two Rivers and Four Lakes · Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area. The Two Rivers and Four Lakes refer to the Lijiang River, Taohua River, Shanhu Lake, Ronghu Lake, Guihu Lake and Mulong Lake. The scenic area integrates Guilin's natural landscapes with humanistic landscapes. As the emblem of Guilin, Elephant Trunk Hill is named because its shape resembles an elephant standing by the river drinking water. Its unique karst landform is a masterpiece of long-term erosion by nature, and it is especially beautiful when the lights are on at night.

Next is Guilin Reed Flute Scenic Area, which is famous for the fantastic Reed Flute Cave. Reed Flute Cave is a natural karst cave with stalactites, stalagmites and stone pillars everywhere. After millions of years of geological evolution, it has formed many landscapes such as "Lion Ridge Morning Glow" and "Crystal Palace". The landscapes in the cave are of various shapes, like a fairy tale world, so it is known as "the Palace of Art of Nature".

When it comes to Guilin's mountains and waters, the Lijiang River Scenic Area is indispensable. The Lijiang River is the soul carrier of karst landforms. From Guilin to Yangshuo, the Lijiang River section is surrounded by green peak forests on both sides, and the river water is clear to the bottom. Classic landscapes such as "Nine Horses Painting Mountain" and "Huangbu Reflection" make people linger and forget to return. Taking a boat tour on the Lijiang River is like being in a flowing landscape painting, and you can truly feel the artistic conception of "the boat sails in the water, and people travel in the painting".

Finally, we will arrive at Hechi Huanjiang Mulun Karst Ecological Tourism Scenic Area. It is a national nature reserve and preserves the most complete primitive karst forest ecosystem in the world. Different from the karst landscapes in Guilin, this place focuses more on the primitiveness of the ecology. You can see tall karst forests, deep canyons and rare animals and plants, which is a natural classroom to feel the charm of karst ecology.

Dear tourists, our "Karst Exploration Journey" is coming to an end. From the classic karst landscapes in Guilin to the original ecological secrets in Hechi, I believe everyone has fallen in love with the mountains and waters of Guangxi. During this trip, thank you for your cooperation and support. I also hope that the mountains, waters and culture of Guangxi can leave you good memories. There is no feast that never ends. I wish you a safe journey and look forward to meeting you again!

sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, good morning! Welcome to the beautiful Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. I'm Vivian, your guide for this "March 3rd Folk Custom Tour". During the upcoming journey, we will start from Nanning, pass through Chongzuo, and finally arrive in Baise. We will explore the unique charm of the Zhuang nationality's "March 3rd" festival and enjoy the natural and cultural scenery of southern and western Guangxi. Please feel free to tell me if you have any needs during the trip. I hope everyone can have an unforgettable journey!

Guangxi is located in South China, bordering the Beibu Gulf in the south and Vietnam. It is a major sea access for southwest China. The region has 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction, with a total population of about 57 million. There are 12 indigenous ethnic groups living here, including Zhuang, Han, Yao, and Miao. Among them, the Zhuang nationality accounts for 31.4%, making Guangxi the autonomous region with the largest population of ethnic minorities in China. The "March 3rd" song fair of the Zhuang nationality has been included in the national intangible cultural heritage. The bronze drum culture and hydrangea craftsmanship are renowned at home and abroad. The long drum dance of the Yao nationality, the silver forging of the Miao nationality, and the wind and rain bridge of the Dong nationality are all treasures of various ethnic cultures.

Our starting point, Nanning, is the capital of Guangxi, also known as the "Green City". It has 7 districts and 4 counties under its jurisdiction, with a population of about 8.89 million. It is the political and cultural center of the region. The Folk Song Lake International Music Town is a window to showcase ethnic music. Chongzuo is located in southwest Guangxi, bordering Vietnam. It has 7 counties (cities, districts) under its jurisdiction, with a population of about 2.5 million. Karst landforms are widely distributed here, and Mingshi Pastoral is a typical representative. The Zhuang nationality accounts for more than 80% of the population here, and the atmosphere of "March 3rd" is particularly strong. Baise is located in western Guangxi, with 12 counties (cities, districts) under its jurisdiction and a population of about 3.65 million. It is a sacred place of the red revolution. The Jiuzhou Scenic Area in Jingxi combines Zhuang customs with natural scenery, and the hydrangea making technique has been passed down from generation to generation.

First, we come to Nanning Folk Song Lake International Music Town, which is adjacent to the Folk Song Lake Scenic Area. It is a characteristic town integrating music performances and ethnic culture display. Folk song performances are held here all year round. During the "March 3rd" period, singers of various ethnic groups gather here to sing Zhuang folk songs. You can experience the fun of throwing hydrangeas and singing folk songs on the spot. Next to it is the Yilingyan Scenic Area, a typical karst cave landscape formed millions of years ago. The stalactites in the cave are in various shapes, and landscapes such as "Two Lions Greeting Guests" and "Underwater Dragon Palace" are vivid. The cliff carvings of the Zhuang ancestors in the cave show the life traces of the ancient Zhuang people.

Then we go to Mingshi Tourist Resort in Chongzuo, which is built relying on the karst peaks and pastoral scenery on both sides of the Mingshi River, and is known as the "Little Guilin". The Mingshi River is winding, with green bamboos on both sides and Zhuang villages scattered all over. We can take a bamboo raft to drift and enjoy the beautiful scenery of "painting swimming in the water and people sitting in the painting". The ancient Zhuang village in the resort retains the stilted buildings. The villagers will display skills such as hydrangea making and Zhuang brocade weaving. During the "March 3rd" festival, folk activities such as playing bronze drums and dancing the toad dance are also held.

Finally, we arrive at Jiuzhou Scenic Area in Jingxi, Baise. It is the location of the ancient Jingxi Prefecture, with a history of thousands of years and the birthplace of Zhuang hydrangeas. The Jiuzhou Ancient Town in the scenic area preserves intact Ming and Qing buildings, with winding bluestone roads, ancient opera stages and Wenchang Pavilions standing quietly, witnessing the changes of years. In the hydrangea workshop in the center of the ancient town, you can see Zhuang women making hydrangeas by hand. The hydrangeas here are exquisitely made and symbolize Zhuang's love and blessings. The landscape around the scenic area is beautiful. The Equan River passes through the area, forming a pleasant contrast with the ancient town, showing the charm of "landscape border town, beautiful Zhuang village".

Dear tourists, our "March 3rd Folk Custom Tour" is coming to an end. sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, hello! I'm Vivian, the tour guide for this "Northern Guangxi Ethnic Style Tour". It's a great honor to accompany you on this journey full of ethnic charm. In the days ahead, we will visit three ethnic autonomous counties: Longsheng, Sanjiang and Rongshui, to explore the grandeur of Longji Terraces, the elegance of Dong villages and the vitality of Miao culture. Please feel free to tell me if you have any needs during the trip. I hope you will be full of joy and gains!

Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region is located in southern China, bordering Vietnam and adjacent to the Beibu Gulf. It is a major sea access for southwest China. The region has 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction, with a total population of about 57 million, and is home to 12 indigenous ethnic groups including Zhuang, Han, Yao, Miao and Dong. The Zhuang's March 3rd Song Festival and hydrangea craftsmanship, the Yao's long drum dance, the Dong's drum towers and wind-rain bridges, and the Miao's silver forging techniques are all treasures of ethnic culture. Among them, the Dong Grand Chorus and the Zhuang brocade weaving technique have been included in the national intangible cultural heritage list.

Longsheng, Sanjiang and Rongshui on our itinerary are all located in the mountainous areas of northern Guangxi, which are concentrated habitats of ethnic minorities. Longsheng Multi-ethnic Autonomous County is home to Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong and other ethnic groups, with a population of about 170,000, and is famous for its terraced farming culture. Sanjiang Dong Autonomous County has the highest proportion of Dong population in China, with a population of about 380,000. The Dong culture is well-preserved, and drum towers and wind-rain bridges are scattered throughout urban and rural areas. Rongshui Miao Autonomous County is the core area of Miao settlement, with a population of about 520,000. It has rich Miao folk customs and colorful festival activities.

First, we come to Longsheng Longji Terraces Scenic Area, which was built in the Yuan Dynasty and has a history of more than 700 years. It is the crystallization of the wisdom of the Zhuang and Yao ancestors. The terraces have a maximum altitude of 1,180 meters and a minimum of 380 meters, overlapping layer by layer like a ladder extending upwards. It combines agricultural production and artistic beauty, and is known as "the fingerprint of the earth". The core landscapes, Jinkeng Terraces and Ping'an Terraces, have smooth lines. In spring, the terraces filled with water are like mirrors; in autumn, the rice waves roll, which is of great ornamental value.

Next are Chengyang Eight Villages and Yueye Dong Village in Sanjiang. Chengyang Eight Villages is a typical representative of Dong villages, with the national key cultural relics protection unit - Chengyang Yongji Bridge. This wind-rain bridge was built in 1916, with an all-wooden mortise and tenon structure without a single nail or rivet, which is the pinnacle of Dong architectural art. Yueye Dong Village focuses on the "Yueye" folk custom. You can experience activities such as the door-blocking wine and Dong Grand Chorus, and feel the enthusiasm of the Dong people.

Finally, there is Rongshui Mengwu Miao Village Folk Culture Experience Park, which is a village rebuilt by the Miao people and completely preserves the Miao stilted buildings. Here, you can watch the Miao Lusheng dance and the silver jewelry making process, taste special foods such as sour soup fish and glutinous rice, and participate in interactive projects such as the hall-stepping dance in Miao festivals to deeply understand the profound heritage of Miao culture. During the tour, we will follow the route of "Terrace Viewing - Dong Village Charm - Miao Village Experience" to take you to experience the ethnic customs of northern Guangxi in an all-round way.

Dear tourists, the wonderful "Northern Guangxi Ethnic Style Tour" is coming to an end. I believe the grandeur of Longji Terraces, the exquisiteness of Dong architecture and the vitality of Miao culture have all become unforgettable memories in your hearts. During this journey, we not only enjoyed the beautiful scenery, but also felt the cultural charm of the harmonious coexistence of multiple ethnic groups in Guangxi. Thank you for your cooperation and support. I look forward to meeting you again in the beautiful Guangxi. Wish you a safe journey and all the best!

sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, hello! I'm Vivian, the guide for this "Northwest Guangxi Ethnic Customs Tour". It's a great honor to start this journey with you to explore the cultural treasures of ethnic minorities such as the Mulao, Maonan and Bai Ku Yao. In the following itinerary, we will start from Luocheng Mulao Autonomous County, pass through Huanjiang Maonan Autonomous County, and finally arrive at Nandan County to experience the unique ethnic customs of the three regions. First, let's introduce the overview of Guangxi. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region is located in South China, bordering the Beibu Gulf in the south and Vietnam. It is the only coastal ethnic autonomous region in China. The region has 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction, with a total population of about 57 million, and 12 ethnic groups including Zhuang, Han, Yao, Miao, Dong, Mulao and Maonan have lived here for generations. The Zhuang's March 3rd Song Festival and bronze drum culture, the Yao's long drum dance and silver jewelry craftsmanship are renowned at home and abroad; the Yifan Festival of the Mulao people and the Fenlong Festival of the Maonan people are unique folk treasures.

The three counties in northwest Guangxi of this itinerary are located at the junction of Guangxi and Guizhou, which is the core area where multiple ethnic groups live together. Luocheng Mulao Autonomous County is the only Mulao autonomous county in China, with a population of about 380,000, of which the Mulao people account for 12%. Its paper-cutting and embroidery techniques have been inherited for thousands of years. Huanjiang Maonan Autonomous County is the only Maonan autonomous county in China, with a population of about 370,000, of which the Maonan people account for 16%. The bamboo hat weaving technique is listed as a national intangible cultural heritage. Nandan County has a population of about 310,000, and the Bai Ku Yao account for 8% of the county's population. They are known as "living fossils of human civilization", and their bronze drum customs and costume culture are of great research value.

The first stop is Luocheng Cotton Tiankeng Resort, which is centered on the rare geological landscape of "tiankeng + karst cave + waterfall". The tiankeng has a diameter of about 320 meters and a depth of 180 meters, with various stalactites in the cave. It is not only a geological wonder but also a window for displaying Mulao culture. We can watch Mulao song and dance performances and experience paper-cutting.

The second stop is Huanjiang Colorful Maonan Scenic Area, a concentrated carrier of Maonan culture. The Maonan Museum in the scenic area shows the origin and customs of the Fenlong Festival - on the 13th day of the fifth lunar month every year, Maonan compatriots worship the dragon god and pray for a good harvest. The core landscape, the Flower Bamboo Hat Workshop, allows you to witness the weaving process of the flower bamboo hat, one of the "three treasures of the Maonan people". It is woven with fine bamboo strips into exquisite patterns, implying auspiciousness.

The last stop is Nandan County. First, we will visit Ge Yasigu, which means "a place with beautiful Yao girls" and is a Bai Ku Yao ecological folk custom park. The complete stilted buildings are preserved here. We can visit the Yao village dwellings and watch the Bai Ku Yao bronze drum dance performance - the bronze drum is the "sacred object" of the Yao village, and the drumbeat carries historical memories. Then we will go to Yaowang Tianxia Scenic Area. Climbing to the top, we can overlook the panoramic view of the Yao village. The folk experience hall in the scenic area allows you to experience the production of Bai Ku Yao costumes. The costumes are characterized by white trousers, and the embroidery patterns record the national migration history. The tourist route will be carried out in the order of "tiankeng exploration - Maonan culture experience - Yao village style immersion", taking into account both natural landscapes and cultural experiences throughout the whole process.

Dear tourists, this Northwest Guangxi Ethnic Customs Tour is coming to an end. I believe you have not only appreciated the geological wonders of the Cotton Tiankeng but also felt the simple customs and profound culture of the Mulao, Maonan and Bai Ku Yao. This journey is more beautiful because of your company. Thank you for your cooperation and support. The landscapes and ethnic cultures of Guangxi will always welcome you. Looking forward to meeting you again. Wish you a smooth return journey and all the best!

sections.text: Dear respected tourists, good morning! Welcome to the beautiful Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. I'm Vivian, your guide for this "Historical and Cultural City Tour". It's a great honor to accompany you on this journey of historical and cultural exploration covering Guilin, Liuzhou and Beihai. During the upcoming trip, we will wander through the millennium-old royal city, touch the wisdom of the Lingqu Canal, cherish the memory of ancient sages, and trace the glory of the Han Dynasty Silk Road. Please feel free to tell me if you have any needs during the trip. I hope you can feel the profound history and beautiful landscapes in Guangxi and have an unforgettable time!

First, let's briefly introduce the overview of Guangxi and the cities in this itinerary. Located in southern China, Guangxi borders Vietnam, with 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction and a total population of about 57 million, among which the Zhuang nationality accounts for 31.4%. It has convenient transportation, with an extensive network of high-speed railways, aviation and water transportation. It has a subtropical monsoon climate, with warm seasons and abundant precipitation. Guangxi has a long history: it was set as Guilin Prefecture in the Qin Dynasty and an important node of the Maritime Silk Road in the Han Dynasty. It has diverse folk customs, such as the Zhuang nationality's San Yue San (Third Month Festival) and the Miao nationality's Lusheng Festival. Specialties include Guilin rice noodles, Liuzhou snail noodles and Beihai shell carvings. Its economy is mainly based on industry, agriculture and tourism, and tourism is booming relying on landscape and cultural resources.

The three cities in this itinerary have their own characteristics: Guilin, located in northeastern Guangxi, is a national historical and cultural city with a total population of about 4.9 million. The Xianggui High-speed Railway passes through the city, and the climate is mild and humid. Its history can be traced back to the Qin Dynasty. Famous for "clear mountains, beautiful waters, strange caves and beautiful stones", it has core landscapes such as Solitary Beauty Peak & Royal City and Lingqu Canal. Tourism is a pillar industry, and it is also promoting the in-depth integration of culture and tourism. Liuzhou, located in central Guangxi, has a total population of about 4.1 million. It is a transportation hub in southwest China with a subtropical monsoon humid climate. Known as "Dragon City" in ancient times, it was established in the Qin Dynasty. Liuhou Park witnesses Liu Zongyuan's achievements in governing Liuzhou. It is a major industrial city, and the snail noodle industry promotes the spread of food culture. Beihai, located in the southern end of Guangxi, has a total population of about 1.8 million. It has important ports such as Beihai Port and a warm and humid climate. It was the seat of Hepu Prefecture in the Han Dynasty and one of the starting ports of the Maritime Silk Road. Hepu Han Dynasty Cultural Museum houses a large number of Silk Road cultural relics, and its marine economy and tourism develop in coordination.

Now we come to Solitary Beauty Peak & Royal City Scenic Area in Guilin, a national 5A-level scenic spot located in the center of Guilin, covering a total area of about 200,000 square meters. It is the site of the Jingjiang Prince's Mansion in the Ming Dynasty and the best-preserved remaining Ming Dynasty feudal prince's mansion in China. The scenic area has a history dating back to the Southern Dynasties. In the Sui Dynasty, it became the seat of Guizhou Prefecture. In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang granted his grandnephew Zhu Shouqian the title of Prince of Jingjiang, who built the mansion here, taking 20 years to complete.

The core landscape, Solitary Beauty Peak, is 216 meters above sea level. It gets its name from being "a single peak that is unmatched by other mountains". Climbing to the top, you can overlook the panoramic view of Guilin. There are many cliff carvings on the mountain, among which the inscription "Pillar of the Southern Sky" is the most famous. The Royal City has main buildings such as Cheng Yun Gate and Cheng Yun Hall, showing the majesty of the prince's mansion. The important figure Zhu Shouqian was enfeoffed here. In the Qing Dynasty, it became the Guangxi Examination Hall, which produced 4 top scholars and 585 successful candidates in the imperial examination.

The tour route can start from Cheng Yun Gate, visit the Examination Hall to experience the imperial examination culture, climb Solitary Beauty Peak to enjoy the panoramic view, and finally visit the Royal Mansion Museum. The scenic area contains the architectural art of the Ming Dynasty and the value of imperial examination culture, and is an important material object for studying the feudal prince system.

Next is the Xing'an Lingqu Canal Scenic Area, located in Xing'an County, Guilin, a national 4A-level scenic spot. As one of the oldest artificial canals in the world, it is known as one of the three major water conservancy projects in ancient China together with Dujiangyan and the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal. With a total length of 37.4 kilometers, it was built in the 33rd year of the First Emperor of Qin (214 BC) under the auspices of Shi Lu, aiming to connect the Xiangjiang River and Lijiang River and solve the problem of grain and grass transportation for the Qin army's southern expedition.

Representative landscapes include the Plowshare Mouth, the Large and Small Balances, the South Canal and the North Canal. The Plowshare Mouth is shaped like a plowshare, diverting the water source of the Xiangjiang River; the Large and Small Balances adjust the water level and have the function of flood discharge. The important event is that after the construction of the Lingqu Canal in the Qin Dynasty, the Lingnan region was officially incorporated into China's territory.

The tour route starts from the scenic area entrance, first visits the Lingqu Canal Museum to learn about the history, then walks along the South Canal to enjoy the Plowshare Mouth and the Large and Small Balances, and finally visits the Qin Dyke scenery. The Lingqu Canal contains extremely high scientific value. Its water diversion and regulation technology is a model of ancient water conservancy projects. At the same time, it witnesses the cultural integration between the Central Plains and Lingnan, and has important historical significance.

Now we are in Liuhou Park in Liuzhou, a commemorative park built to honor Liu Zongyuan, a great litterateur and statesman of the Tang Dynasty. As a national 4A-level scenic spot, it is located in the center of Liuzhou, covering a total area of about 15.52 hectares. It was first built in the second year of Changqing in the Tang Dynasty (822 AD) and has been renovated for thousands of years. Most of the existing buildings were rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty.

The core landscapes of the scenic area include Liuhou Temple, Liu Zongyuan's Cloth Tomb and Ganxiang Pavilion. The Liuhou Temple preserves precious steles such as the "Litchi Stele". The inscription was written by Han Yu, calligraphed by Su Shi, and records Liu Zongyuan's deeds, known as the "Three Wonders Stele". The important figure Liu Zongyuan was demoted to be the governor of Liuzhou in the 10th year of Yuanhe in the Tang Dynasty (815 AD). During his tenure, he established schools, released slaves and opened wells, and was deeply loved by the people. After his death, the people built a temple to commemorate him.

The tour route starts from the main gate, first visits Liuhou Temple to appreciate the stele inscriptions and cultural relics, then goes to Liu Zongyuan's Cloth Tomb to pay tribute, and finally rests in Ganxiang Pavilion to enjoy the garden scenery. The park contains profound cultural heritage and is an important place for studying Liu Zongyuan's thoughts and Tang Dynasty culture. Its commemorative buildings and garden layout also have high artistic value.

Finally, we come to Hepu Han Dynasty Cultural Museum, located in Hepu County, Beihai, a national 4A-level scenic spot. It is a thematic museum focusing on collecting and displaying cultural relics unearthed from Han Dynasty tombs in Hepu. It has a collection of more than 10,000 cultural relics, including 21 first-class cultural relics. The museum was first built in 1978, and the new museum opened in 2016.

The overview of the scenic area takes the "Pearl of the Maritime Silk Road - Hepu Han Dynasty Culture Exhibition" as the core exhibition, showing Hepu's historical status as the starting port of the Maritime Silk Road in the Han Dynasty. Representative cultural relics include the bronze phoenix lamp, colored glaze cup and agate string ornaments. Among them, the bronze phoenix lamp has an exquisite shape and environmental protection function, and is a national first-class cultural relic. The important event is that in the Han Dynasty, Hepu became an important hub for trade between China and Southeast Asia and South Asia by virtue of its convenient port conditions. The unearthed cultural relics confirm the prosperous Silk Road trade at that time.

The tour route follows the exhibition sequence, starting from the "Unification of Qin and Han" exhibition area to understand the historical background of Hepu, then visiting the "Maritime Silk Road" exhibition area to appreciate various trade cultural relics, and finally experiencing Han Dynasty culture in the interactive area. The museum contains extremely high historical and scientific value. It is an important material evidence witnessing the history of the Maritime Silk Road and provides rich physical materials for the study of foreign exchanges in the Han Dynasty.

Dear tourists, our "Historical and Cultural City Tour" is coming to an end. During this journey, we felt the grandeur of the Qin and Han Dynasties from the Royal City and Lingqu Canal in Guilin, cherished the memory of the virtuous officials of the Tang Dynasty in Liuhou Park in Liuzhou, and explored the glory of the Silk Road in Hepu Han Dynasty Cultural Museum in Beihai. I believe that Guangxi's historical heritage, landscape scenery and folk customs have left a deep impression on everyone. Thank you very much for your cooperation and support along the way. Please forgive me if there is any inadequacy in my service. Farewell is not the end. Guangxi's door is always open for you. We look forward to your visit again. Wish you a smooth return journey and all the best!

sections.text: Dear friends, welcome to Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region! I'm your tour guide. Over the next few days, we'll embark on a "Lingnan Culture Tour" covering Wuzhou, Yulin and Guigang. These cities are gems of Lingnan culture, where ancient architecture, traditional operas and time-honored customs are well-preserved. Let's explore their unique charms together!

Guangxi, located in southern China, borders Vietnam and adjoins Guangdong, Guizhou, Yunnan and Hunan. It has 14 prefecture-level cities, a population of about 57 million. With a subtropical monsoon climate, it enjoys mild weather and abundant rainfall. As a transportation hub connecting southwest China to Southeast Asia, it has a developed network of railways, highways and waterways.

Our first stop Wuzhou, "Gateway of Lingnan", is Guangxi's eastern gate with 2200-year history. Population is about 2.8 million. It's a water and land transportation hub, famous for Cantonese opera, qilou buildings and Longmu Temple. Local specialties include Wuzhou rice noodles and cinnamon.

Yulin, in southeastern Guangxi, has 12 counties/cities, population about 7.4 million. It's a key transportation node with a history of over 2000 years. Folk customs like Yulin lion dance are vivid, and specialties include Yulin beef balls and litchi. Rongzhou Ancient City is its cultural landmark.

Guigang, in central Guangxi, has 5 counties/cities, population about 5.6 million. It's a water transport hub along the Xijiang River, with a subtropical climate. Caijia Opera in Youli Village is a local intangible cultural heritage. Specialties include Guigang lotus root and rice cakes.

First, Wuzhou Qilou City & Longmu Temple. Qilou City, with over 500 qilou buildings built in late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, is the largest and best-preserved qilou cluster in Lingnan. These buildings combine Chinese and Western styles, with arcades for shelter from rain and sun. Longmu Temple, founded in Sui Dynasty, honors Longmu, a revered figure in Lingnan folklore who tamed floods. Its main hall and dragon-shaped corridors are architectural highlights.

Next is Wuzhou Cantonese Opera Protection and Inheritance Base. Cantonese Opera, a national intangible cultural heritage, thrives here. The base displays costumes, musical instruments and scripts, and holds regular performances. You can watch artists' rehearsals and even learn basic moves, experiencing the charm of "Lingnan Opera Treasure".

Then Rongzhou Ancient City in Yulin. With a history of 1700 years, it was the administrative center of Rongzhou in Tang and Song Dynasties. The restored city wall, archways and Confucian Temple are well-preserved. The Duyu Memorial Hall honors Du Yu, a famous Tang Dynasty poet who served here. Walking on the ancient streets, you'll feel the prosperity of old Rongzhou.

Finally, Caijia Opera in Youli Village, Guiping. This folk opera has a 300-year history, originated from tea-picking activities. Performances are lively with local dialects, telling rural stories. The costumes are simple but vivid, and musical instruments like suona add fun. It's a living treasure of Lingnan rural culture.

Dear friends, our "Lingnan Culture Tour" is coming to an end. We've appreciated qilou architecture, listened to Cantonese Opera and Caijia Opera, and felt the profound Lingnan culture in Wuzhou, Yulin and Guigang. Thank you for your cooperation. May the charm of Guangxi stay with you forever! Wish you a safe journey and welcome back again!

sections.text: Dear guests, welcome aboard our "Luoyue Culture Tour"! I'm your tour guide Vivian. Over the next few days, we'll explore Nanning and Chongzuo, tracing the footsteps of the ancient Luoyue people. Luoyue culture, a precious part of China's ethnic culture, has left rich heritage here. Let's embark on this journey to uncover its mysteries together!

Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region is located in southern China, bordering Vietnam to the south. It has 14 prefecture-level cities, a population of about 57 million. With a convenient transportation network of airports, high-speed railways and highways, it enjoys a subtropical monsoon climate with mild weather year-round.

Guangxi has a long history. The Luoyue people, an ancestor of the Zhuang ethnic group, once thrived here. Folk customs are unique—Zhuang's Singing Festival, bronze drum culture are well-known. Specialties include osmanthus tea, star anise and Zhuang brocade. Key landscapes cover karst mountains and ethnic villages. Its economy booms with border trade and tourism; culture and society develop steadily.

Nanning, the capital, is "Green City" with 7.46 million people. It's a transportation hub and cultural center. Chongzuo, with 2.5 million people, borders Vietnam. It's the core area of Luoyue culture, famous for Huashan Rock Art and Zhuang culture.

First, Guangxi Museum and Guangxi Ethnic Museum in Nanning. Guangxi Museum, founded in 1934, houses over 50,000 cultural relics. Its Luoyue culture exhibition displays bronze drums and jade artifacts, reflecting ancient Luoyue's social life. Guangxi Ethnic Museum, focusing on ethnic culture, has a Luoyue exhibition area showing housing and tools, presenting Luoyue's living customs.

Then Chongzuo Zhuang Museum, the only museum specializing in Zhuang culture in Chongzuo. It showcases Luoyue's history with cultural relics like stone tools and pottery. The bronze drum display is a highlight—bronze drums were used in rituals, embodying Luoyue's art and belief.

Huashan Rock Art Scenic Area is a world heritage site. Created 2000-5000 years ago, it has over 1900 rock paintings on cliffs. Most depict human figures, animals and rituals, recording Luoyue's life and beliefs. It's a masterpiece of ancient rock art, with high historical and artistic value. We'll visit the core viewing area and learn about painting techniques via the exhibition hall.

Dear guests, our "Luoyue Culture Tour" is coming to an end. We've visited museums and Huashan Rock Art, feeling the charm of Luoyue culture. Thank you for your support and cooperation. May the memories of Guangxi stay with you. Wish you a safe journey and welcome back again!
