sections.text: Dear respected tourists, hello! I'm Vivian, the tour guide who will accompany you on the "Longevity Leisure Tour" today. It's a great honor to walk into the landscapes of Hezhou, Guangxi with all of you and explore the secrets of longevity. During the upcoming trip, we will visit Pinggui District, Babu District and Zhaoping County in turn, encountering the freshness of Gupo Mountain, the warmth of Xixi Forest Hot Spring and the tranquility of Huangyao Ancient Town. Please keep your personal belongings safe, relax, and let's start this leisurely longevity journey!

Before the trip starts, let's first understand the basic situation of Guangxi and Hezhou. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region is located in South China, adjacent to Guangdong in the east, bordering the Beibu Gulf in the south, and bordering Vietnam in the southwest. It is the only ethnic minority autonomous region with a coastline in China. The region has 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction, with a total area of 237,600 square kilometers and a permanent population of about 50.47 million, of which the Zhuang population accounts for 31.4%. All ethnic groups live in harmony and their cultures blend.

One of Guangxi's most prominent business cards is "Hometown of Longevity". At present, there are 29 counties (cities, districts) in the region that have won the title of "China's Hometown of Longevity", ranking first in the country in number, forming a unique longevity cultural circle. The longevity code here is inseparable from the high-quality ecological environment - the forest coverage rate reaches 62.55%, and the fresh air, mineral-rich water sources and green and healthy diet have all laid a solid foundation for longevity.

Hezhou, the destination of our trip, is located in the northeastern part of Guangxi, at the junction of Hunan, Guangdong and Guangxi provinces (regions), known as the "Gateway to Eastern Guangxi". It has 2 districts, 3 counties and 1 city under its jurisdiction, including Babu District, Pinggui District and Zhaoping County, with a total area of 11,855 square kilometers and a permanent population of about 2.49 million. Hezhou is also a gathering place of longevity resources in Guangxi. Zhaoping County, Babu District and Pinggui District are all "China's Hometown of Longevity". With beautiful mountains and rivers and profound cultural heritage, it is an excellent place to experience a long and leisurely life.

We will first arrive at Hezhou Gupo Mountain Scenic Area in Pinggui District. Gupo Mountain is a national 4A-level scenic area with a main peak of 1,844 meters above sea level and a forest coverage rate of up to 99.5%, known as "the largest natural oxygen bar in South China". There are not only waterfalls, springs, strange mountains and rocks here, but also a famous "hometown of tea". The high-altitude tea produced here is fragrant and mellow, which is a healthy drink often consumed by local elderly people with longevity. The Xiangu Waterfall in the scenic area has a drop of more than 80 meters, and the negative ion content is extremely high when the water splashes. Take a deep breath, and you will be full of freshness and comfort.

Then we will go to Hezhou Xixi Forest Hot Spring Resort in Babu District. This resort is built relying on natural hot spring resources. The hot spring water comes from 1,500 meters underground, rich in silicic acid, fluorine, strontium and other minerals beneficial to the human body, and is known as "health-preserving hot spring". Local elderly people often say, "Soak in Xixi Spring, and you will be energetic all day long." The warmth of the hot spring can not only relieve fatigue, but also nourish the body and mind, which is one of the important ways for longevity and health preservation. The resort is surrounded by forests, and you can enjoy the landscape while soaking in the hot spring, which is very comfortable.

Finally, we will arrive at Huangyao Ancient Town in Zhaoping County. With a history of nearly a thousand years, this ancient town is a national 5A-level scenic area, preserving a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The bluestone roads, ancient bridges and ancient dwellings are scattered in an orderly manner, known as "a living thousand-year-old ancient town". The ancient town is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the clear Yao River flows through the town. People here maintain a simple life of working at sunrise and resting at sunset. Their diet is mainly rice, vegetables and river fresh produce locally, which is light and healthy. Wandering through the ancient town and feeling the slow-paced life, maybe you can understand the true meaning of longevity.

Dear tourists, our "Longevity Leisure Tour" is coming to an end. I believe that the freshness of Gupo Mountain, the warmth of Xixi Hot Spring and the tranquility of Huangyao Ancient Town have made everyone feel the unique charm of Hezhou's longevity culture. The landscapes of Guangxi nourish life, and the humanities of Hezhou warm people's hearts. I hope this trip will leave you good memories, and I wish all friends good health and long life. Looking forward to meeting you again in the beautiful Guangxi, goodbye!

sections.text: Dear distinguished tourists, good morning! Welcome to the beautiful Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and start our several-day "Longevity and Health Preservation Tour". I am your tour guide for this trip, my name is Vivian, and you can call me Xiao Wei. In the following journey, I will accompany you all the way to Bama, Donglan and Fengshan, the three blessed lands of longevity, to explore the secrets of longevity and enjoy the comfort of health preservation. If you have any needs or questions during the trip, please feel free to ask me, and I will try my best to solve them for you. Now, let's set off with full expectation!

First of all, let me introduce the basic situation of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Located in South China, Guangxi borders the Beibu Gulf in the south, Guangdong Province in the east, Hunan Province in the northeast, Guizhou Province in the northwest, Yunnan Province in the west, and Vietnam in the southwest. It is the only coastal ethnic autonomous region in China with a superior geographical location. The total area of the region is 237,600 square kilometers, governing 14 prefecture-level cities and 109 counties (cities, districts), with a total population of about 57 million, of which the Zhuang population accounts for 31.4%. All ethnic groups live in harmony here and have jointly created a rich and colorful ethnic culture.

When it comes to Guangxi, we have to mention the shining business card of "longevity". Guangxi is the region with the most concentrated longevity townships in China. At present, it has many "China's Longevity Townships" such as Bama, Donglan, Fengshan, Zhaoping and Cenxi. Among them, Bama, Donglan and Fengshan in our itinerary are known as the "Longevity Golden Triangle". The longevity phenomenon here is not accidental. The unique natural environment is the foundation—sufficient negative oxygen ions, small molecule water rich in minerals, pollution-free soil and crops, plus the local residents' light diet structure, optimistic and open-minded attitude and long-standing inheritance of longevity culture, which together have created the longevity miracle here.

Next, let's introduce the destinations of our itinerary. The first stop is Bama Yao Autonomous County, which is under the jurisdiction of Hechi City, with a total population of about 300,000, of which the Yao and other ethnic minorities account for more than 85%. Bama is a world-famous longevity township, and the number of centenarians per 100,000 people is far higher than the standard of world longevity townships, known as "World Longevity Township · Chinese Longevity Holy Land". The second stop is Donglan County, also under the jurisdiction of Hechi City, with a total population of about 310,000. It is "China's Longevity Township" and "China's Famous Ecological Health Tourism County". It not only has beautiful natural scenery, but also has a profound red cultural heritage. The third stop is Fengshan County, with a total population of about 180,000. Located on the southern edge of the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, it has beautiful mountains and clear waters, and an excellent ecological environment. It is "China's Longevity Township" and "China's Most Beautiful County", and is known as the "Karst Cave Museum".

Panyang River is the "mother river" of Bama and also a "longevity river". With a total length of 145 kilometers, the river water is clear to the bottom and rich in selenium, strontium and other minerals beneficial to the human body. The scenic area covers three core scenic spots: Baimo Cave, Bainiao Cave and Cifu Lake. Baimo Cave is known as a "natural oxygen bar", with the negative oxygen ion concentration in the cave as high as more than 100,000 per cubic centimeter. The stalactites in the cave are in various shapes and forms, which is amazing. Bainiao Cave is a unique water karst cave. Taking a bamboo raft into the cave, the light and shadow change, and birds sing happily, as if entering a fairyland. Cifu Lake is an artificial lake in the lower reaches of Panyang River. With a wide lake surface, rippling blue waves and surrounded by green mountains, it is an excellent place for leisure and health preservation.

Crystal Palace is another wonder in Bama. It is named because the stalactites in the cave are snow-white and crystal clear, like crystals. The temperature in the cave is kept at 18-22℃ all year round, and the humidity is suitable, making it a natural "air-conditioned room". Walking in the cave, you can see countless stalagmites, stone pillars and stone curtains standing like crystal carvings, shining brightly under the light, as if entering a dreamy crystal world. The stalactites here are still growing, which has high ornamental and scientific research value.

Hongshui River is the main stream of the Xijiang River system in the Pearl River Basin. It turns a huge "U"-shaped bend in Donglan County, known as the "First Bay of Hongshui River". Looking from the viewing platform, the Hongshui River winds like a red dragon among the mountains. The green mountains on both sides are continuous, with dense vegetation, and the mountains and rivers depend on each other, which is magnificent. The sunrise and sunset here are particularly spectacular. When the sun sets, the sunset glow reflects on the river, sparkling and extremely beautiful. At the same time, the water of Hongshui River is rich in minerals, nourishing the creatures on both sides and nurturing the longevity culture of Donglan.

Sanmenhai is a typical core area of karst landform in the world. It is named because it has three natural stone gates and is known as the "sky pit on the sea". It is composed of seven sky pits, and three have been developed so far. Taking a bamboo raft to travel through it, you can pass through three stone gates in turn. The stalactites in the cave are peculiar, the water is green, and the light and shadow are intertwined, like a paradise. The concentration of negative oxygen ions in the scenic area is extremely high, which is a veritable "natural health resort" and an excellent place to explore the mysteries of karst landforms.

Dear tourists, our "Longevity and Health Preservation Tour" is coming to an end. In the past few days, we have appreciated the clarity of Bama Panyang River, the magic of Crystal Palace, felt the grandeur of the First Bay of Donglan Hongshui River, and experienced the tranquility of Fengshan Sanmenhai. I believe that everyone has not only enjoyed the beauty of Guangxi's mountains and rivers, but also felt the charm of longevity culture, and gained physical and mental relaxation and pleasure.

There is no feast that never ends. Although the journey is coming to an end, Guangxi's mountains, rivers and enthusiasm will always welcome everyone. I hope this journey will become a good memory in your hearts, and I also hope you can share the longevity secrets and beautiful scenery of Guangxi with your relatives and friends. Finally, I wish you a safe journey, good health and all the best! Looking forward to seeing you next time!

Lingyun is not only a longevity hometown, but also a "hometown of famous teas in China", where mountains, rivers and tea fragrance blend perfectly. Leye County, which we will visit next, is also under the jurisdiction of Baise City. It covers a total area of 2617 square kilometers with a total population of about 160,000. In addition to the longevity reputation, it is more famous for its spectacular sinkhole group in the world, known as the "Capital of Sinkholes in the World".

Now we are in Lingyun Huanhaokun Lake Landscape Ecological Experience Area. Haokun Lake is the source lake of the Tuoniang River in the Pearl River Basin, with a lake surface area of about 20 square kilometers. Surrounded by mountains, the vegetation coverage rate is over 90%. The lake water here is clear to the bottom, with visibility up to 5-8 meters. The negative oxygen ion content in the air is extremely high, exceeding 20,000 per cubic centimeter, making it a natural "air oxygen bar". Wandering on the plank road by the lake, listening to the singing of birds and insects, and watching the lake and mountain scenery, you feel as if you are in a fairyland. Local elders often say that drinking the water of Haokun Lake and breathing the air here every day is the secret of longevity.

Next is Lingyun Tea Mountain Pyramid Scenic Area. It is famous for its unique "pyramid"-shaped tea gardens. The layered tea gardens are built along the mountains, extending from the foot of the mountain to the top. From a distance, they look like green pyramids. The scenic area has a tea garden area of about 10,000 mu, mainly planting Lingyun white hair tea. This kind of tea is rich in amino acids and a variety of trace elements, with a fresh and sweet taste. It is a healthy tea drink for local people's daily consumption and has become an important part of the longevity diet. Here, you can experience the fun of picking and making tea, and also taste a cup of fresh pre-Ming tea to feel the integration of tea fragrance and mountains and rivers.

Finally, we will go to Leye Dashiwei Sinkhole Group Scenic Area. It is the largest sinkhole group in the world, composed of more than 20 sinkholes. Among them, Dashiwei Sinkhole is the most spectacular, with a vertical depth of 613 meters and a pit mouth diameter of about 600 meters, known as the "Sinkhole Museum". The internal ecosystem of the sinkhole is complete, with many rare animals and plants and a mysterious underground river. Wandering on the viewing platform at the edge of the sinkhole, overlooking the deep pit bottom, you can feel the magic of nature. The unique geological environment and ecological resources here also provide a healthy living foundation for local residents, becoming another important carrier of longevity culture.

Dear tourists, our "Longevity Dynamic Tour" is coming to an end. From Haokun Lake and Tea Mountain Pyramid in Lingyun to Dashiwei Sinkhole Group in Leye, I believe you have not only appreciated the magnificent mountains and rivers of Guangxi, but also felt the unique charm of longevity culture. During this trip, thank you for your cooperation and support. I hope the mountains, rivers and humanities of Guangxi can leave a deep impression on you. You are also welcome to come to this longevity blessed land again to explore more wonderful things. Wish you a safe journey and all the best!

name: 广西 米粉之旅

sections.text: Dear friends, welcome to Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region! I'm your tour guide Vivian. Over the next few days, we'll embark on a delicious "Guangxi Rice Noodle Tour" covering Nanning, Liuzhou and Guilin. Rice noodles are the soul of Guangxi's cuisine, and each city has its unique flavor. Let's taste the stories behind every bowl of rice noodles together!

First, let's get to know Guangxi. Located in southern China, bordering Vietnam to the south, Guangxi covers an area of 237,600 square kilometers. It has 14 prefecture-level cities, with a total population of about 57.33 million, among which the Zhuang nationality is the largest ethnic group, accounting for about 31% of the total population.

Guangxi is rich in specialties. For handcrafts, there are Nanning's ivory carvings, Liuzhou's lacquerware and Guilin's rice paper paintings. Local products include Lingyun white tea, Guiping Xishan tea, and rice noodles of course. Famous wines like Donglan rice wine and Hezhou osmanthus wine are also worth trying. Chinese medicinal materials such as Guizhi (cassia twig) and Yizhi (Alpinia oxyphylla) are well-known nationwide. For fruits, sugarcane, longan, lychee and mango are abundant, especially Nanning's mango which is sweet and juicy.

Now let's learn about our itinerary cities. Nanning, the capital, is called the "Green City" with lush vegetation. It has 7 districts and 4 counties, a population of about 8.89 million. Besides old friend rice noodles, it's famous for osmanthus cakes and star anise.

Liuzhou, an important industrial city in southern China, has 5 districts and 5 counties, a population of about 4.17 million. It's not only the home of snail rice noodles but also known for Sanjiang Dong bamboo weaving and Liuzhou snails.

Guilin, a world-famous tourist city, has 6 districts and 10 counties, a population of about 4.94 million. "Guilin's mountains and waters are the best under heaven" is its true portrayal. In addition to Guilin rice noodles, it's famous for osmanthus tea and Guilin fermented tofu.

Our first stop is Nanning. We'll visit People's Park, a landmark with a history of over 100 years, where you can enjoy the green scenery of the "Green City". Then we'll taste Nanning Old Friend Rice Noodles. It's made with rice noodles, pork, shrimp, sour bamboo shoots and other ingredients, cooked quickly in a wok. The soup is sour, spicy, fresh and fragrant, which is said to have originated from a chef who cooked it for a sick friend, hence the name "Old Friend".

Next is Liuzhou. We'll go to Liuzhou Water Wheel Island, where we can see the largest water wheel group in Asia and enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Liujiang River. Then it's the highlight - Liuzhou Snail Rice Noodles. It's famous for its "smelly but delicious" flavor, with ingredients like snail soup, sour bamboo shoots, peanuts and fried tofu skin. The snail soup is simmered for hours, making the taste rich and unique. Don't worry about the "smell"; it's the charm of fermented sour bamboo shoots!

Our last stop is Guilin. We'll take a bamboo raft tour on the Li River, enjoying the picturesque mountains and waters - the green mountains stand like bamboo shoots, and the clear water reflects the scenery. After that, we'll taste Guilin Rice Noodles. It's usually served with a dry sauce made of pork, mushrooms and soy sauce, and you can add soup and side dishes as you like. The rice noodles are smooth and chewy, with a strong sauce flavor.

Dear friends, our "Guangxi Rice Noodle Tour" has come to an end. We've tasted the unique flavors of Nanning Old Friend Rice Noodles, Liuzhou Snail Rice Noodles and Guilin Rice Noodles, and appreciated the beautiful scenery of the three cities. I hope this journey has left you with sweet memories. Guangxi's charm is not only in the food but also in the mountains and waters and the enthusiasm of the people. Welcome to visit Guangxi again! Bon voyage!

name: 广西 工艺品之旅

sections.text: Dear friends, welcome to Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region! I'm your tour guide Vivian. Over the next few days, we'll embark on a "Guangxi Craft Tour" covering Beihai, Qinzhou, Nanning and Baise. Along the way, we'll explore the shimmering Hepu pearls, the rustic Qinzhou Nixing pottery, the vivid Zhuang brocade and the auspicious silk balls. Let's immerse ourselves in Guangxi's craftsmanship heritage together!

Guangxi, located in southern China bordering Vietnam, has 14 prefecture-level cities and a population of about 57 million. It's a melting pot of 12 ethnic groups, with Zhuang as the largest. Crafts are its shining gems: Hepu pearls known as "marine treasures", Qinzhou Nixing pottery (one of China's four famous potteries), Zhuang brocade with bright patterns, and silk balls symbolizing love. Local specialties include longan, lychee, Shatian pomelo, Guilin rice noodles, Liuzhou snail noodles, and teas like Liu'an Gua Pian. Wines such as Dongjiu and Chinese medicinal materials like Guiyuan (longan aril) are also well-known.

Our first stop Beihai, a coastal city, is the hometown of Hepu pearls with a 2000-year pearl-culturing history. Qinzhou, a port city, is renowned for Nixing pottery with unique double-firing technique. Nanning, the capital, is the political and cultural center, gathering crafts from across Guangxi. Baise, in western Guangxi, is the birthplace of Zhuang brocade and silk balls, carrying profound ethnic culture.

In Beihai, we'll visit Hepu Pearl Museum. Here, you'll see "South Sea Pearl Kings" and learn about pearl-culturing techniques. The clear water and suitable temperature make Hepu pearls round and lustrous—once tributes to emperors. Don't miss the pearl-carving crafts, blending delicacy and artistry.

Next in Qinzhou, Nixing Pottery Cultural and Creative Park awaits. Nixing pottery uses local red and purple clay, with patterns formed naturally during firing. Masters will demonstrate pottery-making—you can try kneading clay. The pottery's surface changes color over time with use, making each piece unique.

In Nanning, Zhuang Brocade and Embroidery Exhibition Hall is a must. Zhuang brocade, with a 1000-year history, uses dyed cotton and silk to weave patterns of mountains, rivers and ethnic life. Nearby, you can watch artisans make silk balls—sewn with colored silk, filled with cotton, each representing good luck. It's a perfect souvenir!

In Baise, Zhuang Ethnic Cultural Village shows the origin of these crafts. Elders will share stories: Zhuang brocade was once used as dowry, while silk balls were for young people to express love. You can even learn simple brocade-weaving skills here.

Dear friends, our "Guangxi Craft Tour" is coming to an end. We've witnessed the luster of Hepu pearls, the texture of Nixing pottery, the vibrancy of Zhuang brocade and the warmth of silk balls. These crafts are not just artworks, but carriers of Guangxi's history and ethnic wisdom. I hope this journey leaves you with beautiful memories. Wish you a safe trip and welcome back to Guangxi anytime! Thank you!

name: 广西 茶文化之旅

sections.text: Dear respected tourists, good morning! Welcome to the beautiful Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. I'm Vivian, your tour guide for this "Guangxi Tea Culture Tour". It's a great honor to accompany you on this fragrant journey. During the upcoming trip, we will start from Wuzhou, pass through Guigang and Nanning, and finally arrive in Fangchenggang. We will explore the unique charms of Wuzhou Liubao Tea, Guiping Xishan Tea, Hengzhou Jasmine Tea and Fangchenggang Golden Camellia. Please feel free to tell me if you have any needs during the trip. I hope you can taste the tea fragrance and experience the customs among the green mountains and clear waters of Guangxi.

First of all, let's introduce the basic situation of Guangxi. Located in South China, Guangxi is adjacent to Guangdong in the east, Beibu Gulf in the south, Yunnan in the west, Hunan in the northeast, Guizhou in the northwest, and Vietnam in the southwest. It is the only coastal ethnic autonomous region in China. The total area of the region is 237,600 square kilometers, with 14 prefecture-level cities under its jurisdiction and a permanent population of about 50.47 million, of which the Zhuang nationality accounts for 31.4%. All ethnic groups live in harmony with rich customs.

Guangxi is rich in local products. In terms of handicrafts, Zhuang brocade is bright in color and exquisite in pattern, which is a treasure of Zhuang traditional craftsmanship; Nixing pottery has a delicate texture and is one of the four famous potteries in China. Among local specialties, in addition to the various famous teas we will focus on experiencing this time, there are also well-known delicacies such as Guilin Rice Noodles and Liuzhou Snail Noodles. Fruits are fragrant all year round, such as lychee, longan, mango and Shatian pomelo, which are sweet and sour. Guangxi is also rich in Chinese medicinal materials, with high-quality notoginseng, star anise and cinnamon, and is known as the "Hometown of Southern Medicines". In terms of famous wines, Guilin Sanhua Wine is famous for its "fresh honey fragrance and mellow sweetness in the mouth" and is a representative of Chinese rice-flavored liquor.

Next, let's introduce the cities on our itinerary. The first stop is Wuzhou, located in the east of Guangxi, which is the east gate of Guangxi. It covers a total area of 12,600 square kilometers with a permanent population of about 2.82 million. Wuzhou is a millennium-old city and also a famous "hometown of Liubao Tea" in China. In addition, Guiling Jelly and Paper-wrapped Chicken are unique delicacies here. The second stop is Guigang, located in the southeast of Guangxi, covering a total area of 10,600 square kilometers with a permanent population of about 4.35 million. It is the birthplace of Guiping Xishan Tea, which is famous for its "green color, strong fragrance, sweet taste and beautiful shape". The third stop is Nanning, the capital of Guangxi, located in the south-central part of Guangxi. It covers a total area of 22,100 square kilometers with a permanent population of about 8.89 million and is the political, economic and cultural center of Guangxi. Hengzhou, a county-level city under the jurisdiction of Nanning, is the "hometown of jasmine in China" and its jasmine tea is famous all over the country. The fourth stop is Fangchenggang, located in the south of Guangxi, bordering Beibu Gulf in the south. It covers a total area of 6,200 square kilometers with a permanent population of about 1.05 million. The golden camellia here is a national first-class protected plant, known as the "giant panda in the plant kingdom" and "queen of the tea family".

Our tea culture tour will start with Wuzhou Liubao Tea. As a representative of Chinese dark tea, Wuzhou Liubao Tea has a history of more than 1,500 years and is named after its origin in Liubao Town, Wuzhou. In the Liubao Tea producing area, we can visit ancient tea factories, see the traditional pile fermentation and aging processes, and also brew a cup of Liubao Tea by ourselves to experience its unique flavor of "red, thick, mellow and aged". Liubao Tea not only has a mellow taste, but also has the effects of dispelling dampness and nourishing the stomach, which is very suitable for drinking in the humid climate of southern China.

Then we will go to Guiping Xishan in Guigang. It is not only a national scenic spot, but also the core producing area of Guiping Xishan Tea. Xishan is not high in altitude, but it has a mild climate, lingering clouds and mist, and fertile soil, providing an excellent environment for tea tree growth. We will climb Xishan, walk in the tea garden, and enjoy the beautiful scenery of "good scenery in the mountain and good taste in the tea". We can also taste the freshly picked and fried Xishan Tea in the mountain tea house. Its tea soup is clear and bright, with a fresh and sweet taste that lingers on the aftertaste.

The third stop is Hengzhou, Nanning. We will visit the jasmine planting base and flower tea processing factory. Hengzhou has the largest jasmine planting area in the world. Every July to August, millions of mu of jasmine flowers bloom, and the fragrance fills the whole small city. In the base, we can learn the picking skills of jasmine flowers - the flower buds that are in bud must be picked in the early morning to retain the strongest fragrance. In the processing factory, we can see the whole process of scenting jasmine flowers with green tea. A cup of Hengzhou Jasmine Tea has both the freshness of green tea and the fragrance of jasmine, which is a model of "flowers bring tea fragrance and tea carries flower charm".

The last stop is Fangchenggang, where we will visit the Golden Camellia Nature Reserve. Different from other teas, the golden camellia has golden flowers and thick, shiny petals, like carved gold. It was not discovered until 1960 and is a rare tea species in the world. In the reserve, we can watch clusters of golden camellia trees, learn about their growth habits and protection history, and also taste the tea soup brewed with golden camellia. Its soup color is golden and bright, the taste is fresh and refreshing, and it is highly favored because it is rich in various nutrients.

Dear tourists, our "Guangxi Tea Culture Tour" is coming to an end. From the mellow and aged fragrance of Wuzhou Liubao Tea, to the fresh and sweet aftertaste of Guiping Xishan Tea, from the fragrant and elegant Hengzhou Jasmine Tea, to the rare and unique Fangchenggang Golden Camellia, I believe you have not only tasted the charm of Guangxi's famous teas, but also felt the beauty of Guangxi's mountains and waters and ethnic customs. This journey is more wonderful because of your company. Thank you for your cooperation and support. The tea fragrance of Guangxi will always float for you. Welcome to the beautiful Guangxi again. Wish you a safe and pleasant journey!
